scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @paralleax/api" "npm run dev -w @paralleax/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @paralleax/shared && npm run build -w @paralleax/api && npm run build -w @paralleax/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @paralleax/api && npm run test -w @paralleax/web
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w @paralleax/api && npm run coverage -w @paralleax/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @paralleax/shared && npm run typecheck -w @paralleax/api && npm run typecheck -w @paralleax/web
